translation.Add Twitchify more than once and give ea: Add Twitchify more than once and give each copy a job. A custom panel link (an overlay or alert box made to be embedded, as in an OBS browser source) makes this copy show that page.
translation.Overall applies to everything; the other: Overall applies to everything; the others stack on top of it for one area each. Chat text has its own pixel size under Preferences as well.
translation.On, the accent, background and transpare: On, the accent, background and transparency follow the colours set for this screen in iCUE instead of the ones chosen under Preferences.
